_comment: Empirical band-widening factors applied at chart render time. Archived round artifacts under forecasts/rounds/ are never modified; the correction exists only in the published fan charts.
derivation: Gaussian half-width approximation: k(h, level) = z(nominal) / z(empirical), where z(p) is the standard-normal quantile at (1+p)/2 and empirical is the measured coverage of the nominal band at horizon h. Each band half-width is multiplied by k around the archived median. k below 1 (an over-covering band) narrows it: this is a calibration, not a one-way widening.
extrapolation: The evaluation covers horizons h1-h8; archived rounds run to 13 quarters. For h > 8 the h8 factor is held constant.
caveat: Coverage was measured on series levels in transformed model units (pseudo-out-of-sample, overlapping origins); the published fans show year-on-year growth, so the factors are an approximation.
unemployment_satellite: Left raw. The svar-unemployment (Okun) satellite is not among the series in the coverage evaluation, so no measured factor applies to it; borrowing the boe-svar factors would assert a calibration that was never tested. Its fan is labelled as raw model quantiles.
